execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: KCK-03C1 two-key-pose in-place run strip, not a collage/model sheet. Input image 1 is the ONLY approved Dinosaur master and rendering/identity reference. Make EXACTLY TWO equal-width horizontal slots, ordered LEFT TO RIGHT, with one full-body dinosaur in EACH slot. Each slot has the SAME canvas height, generous transparent margins and SAME character drawing size, camera angle, head/body proportions and baseline. Horizontal strip, no labels, separators, ground, cast shadow or background; genuine transparent alpha. Do not overlap slot borders or clip any tail/prop/foot. These are two running poses of one character, NOT two different characters or an interactive scene. Same reference frontal three-quarter camera and tilted friendly large head in both poses; run in place, no root translation. Preserve exact Soft Handmade 2.5D: warm dark-brown outline, controlled fine paper/pencil grain, mint green body, cream belly with EXACTLY TWO brown curved belly stripes, soft yellow rounded dorsal spikes, peach cheeks, small w-shaped mouth, stubby short legs with toe marks and long curved tail. Do not lengthen legs, change head size, add teeth, add iris/eye white, change tail or spikes. Each open dark eye has two white glints: LARGE primary precisely at upper LEFT (about 35% across, 28% down each eye), SMALL secondary lower RIGHT. Keep the same face/eye anatomy in both poses. The magnifying glass with orange/yellow frame and pale blue lens stays in Dinosaur ANATOMICAL LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT), same hand and same orientation in both frames. Other ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT) stays a free relaxed receiving/carry palm near chest, no snack or tray baked in. Pose 0 LEFT SLOT: running contact pose with anatomical right foot in ground contact, anatomical left foot lifted a little back; keep the raised foot inside slot. Pose 1 RIGHT SLOT: alternate running contact pose, anatomical left foot now in ground contact, anatomical right foot lifted slightly forward. Two visibly different leg poses, clear short-leg run, not duplicated standing stills. Head mass and body height remain constant; no artificial squash, oversized bob, rotation change or built-in motion blur. Use a coherent common baseline and natural anatomy; retain both visible feet where camera permits. Same illumination SCREEN UPPER LEFT across both slots. No extra prop, text, question mark, decorative sparkle or solid matte.
